description: ADM Collingham Link Road is a dataset listed in UK national open data portal, an open data portal, published or maintained by Newark and Sherwood District Council. Indicative line of the Collingham Link Road identified in the Co/MU/1 Mixed Use Allocation within the Allocations & Development Management Development Plan Document (ADM DPD). Coverage: Newark and Sherwood District Council. The portal files it under the publisher Newark and Sherwood District Council. The portal shows 2026-07-08 as the last metadata change. It is reached through the links recorded on this page, with the catalogue entry as the discovery route. Access is free of charge and open. The licence is not stated on the portal listing (dataset page not read). Caveats: this record was written from the catalogue listing only, so the linked page was not opened, its contents and current availability were not checked, and the description may lag the source. It can support traffic, parking and road network studies. Related record: the catalogue-level record data-ckan-uk-portal.
